# Recorded merge ranges from the npm seed repository: one line per range, the
# range name and the recorded merge commit (newest first). Each range directory
# carries that merge's real `git diff --name-status` list plus mechanically
# derived selection skeletons, never the seed's source text:
#
#   e2e/*.mjs     one comment line per `from "./x.mjs"` specifier the file
#                 contains (the helper set the selection excludes), a
#                 `playwright` marker line when the file carries that marker,
#                 and one line per changed path or extension-stripped stem the
#                 file contains (the strings the scoped selection greps for).
#   package.json  the real `scripts` map (the fast gates and the declared e2e
#                 suites are read from it) plus a `typescript` key so the
#                 TypeScript gate stays declared.
#
# Each skeleton keeps exactly the bytes the selection reads, so the frozen seed
# and the engine stay byte-identical over every range; the contrast test
# replays the ranges against the frozen seed.
